js.name: JS Project Info
js.description: Reads package.json — name, version, description, scripts, dependency counts

java.name: Java/Maven Project Info
java.description: Reads pom.xml — groupId, artifactId, version, description, dependency count

ci.name: CI Workflow Info
ci.description: Reads .github/workflows/*.yml — workflow names, triggers, and job names

info.name: Project Info Sheet
info.description: Combines JS, Java, and CI info into a single project sheet via rune composition

js-add-script.name: JS Add Script
js-add-script.description: Adds or updates a script entry in package.json. Args: <name> <command>

js-bump-version.name: JS Bump Version
js-bump-version.description: Increments the patch segment of the version field in package.json

ci-add-job.name: CI Add Job
ci-add-job.description: Adds a bare job to an existing GitHub Actions workflow. Args: <workflow.yml> <job-name>
